Name: Clothesline Variants
Author: n0vacanes
Description:
back at it again at [s]the krispy kreme[/s] stardew mods!!


this mod adds 9 color variants of the clothesline (originally purchasable at the oasis) to the furniture catalogue:
[list]
[*]vanilla
[*]dark
[*]mid tone
[*]desaturated
[*]3 colorways to match [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/BogWyytch/]Bog's[/url]﻿ mods
[*]2 vibrant colorways (pink and teal)
[/list]
currently CP only as i have no clue how AT works and i have too much going on rn to spend time on it rip :')
